opening.argument: The video promises free PUBG Mobile UC and Battle Points, then directs viewers to an external website to enter a username, choose a device, and select the amount they want. The flow does not end there: the speaker instructs viewers to download apps as purported bot verification, and the locked page requires completion of two offers to unlock it. Taken together, the promised free assets and the steps required to pursue them support a deceptive solicitation. The evidence does not establish whether anyone installed the apps, whether information was misused, or whether any rewards were delivered.

citations.quote: Today, I will show you how to get free UC and Battle Points for PUBG MOBILE!
First, go to this website, www.pubgmobile.aecheat.com
Type your username here. Choose your device here.
Now sometimes, the website might want you to prove you're not a bot, so just download an app or two to prove you aren't one.
